experiment.title: Buffer preparation: an acetic acid–sodium acetate buffer of specified pH
experiment.goal:
In buffer_flask (100 mL volumetric flask), prepare an acetic acid–sodium acetate buffer with pH = 4.71 (total acetic acid ~0.1 M), finally diluted to the mark.
Scoring is based on the actual pH of the solution in buffer_flask (tolerance ±0.05), and the solution must be at the mark.
When done, submit with submit_result: quantity = "pH", unit = "", reporting the final pH you measured.
